_tieu_de: Doi chieu markup THAT cua 3 o suy dien tu mau clone (PPP Password, IPv6 WAN Address, IPv6 Gateway Address) -- gap ghi trong ISSUES.md 'GD4 phan 3, 3 cho de ngo, muc 3'.
_cach_do: Vao Advanced > WAN. Doi cuc bo (CHUA Save) IPv4 Connection Type -> PPPoE de React tu ve o 'PPP Password'. Doc DOM qua javascript_tool.
Bam Escape dong popup, KHONG Save. Tai lai trang that su (location.reload(), khong chi navigate cung URL -- SPA giu nguyen state form neu route khong doi, da gap va sua trong luc do).
Doi cuc bo IPv6 Connection Type -> Static (khong dung IPv4, giu nguyen Static goc) de React ve 'IPv6 WAN Address' + 'IPv6 Gateway Address'. Doc DOM.
Bam Cancel de huy toan bo thay doi cuc bo, KHONG bam Save o buoc nao. Thiet bi khong doi gi.
phat_hien_phu_khong_lien_quan: Luc dau tuong 'Static' cua IPv6 bi khoa sai quy tac dau du IPv4 dang la Static -- hoa ra do navigate() toi CUNG URL hash khong lam SPA remount component, form giu nguyen state cuc bo da doi PPPoE truoc do. Sau khi ep reload that (location.reload()), Static IPv6 mo khoa dung nhu code da suy dien (chi khoa khi IPv4=pppoe). KHONG phai loi.
